answer_1.quote: We propose DDxTutor, the first clinical diagnostic tutoring framework that leverages modern LLMs to implement systematic differential diagnosis teaching.
answer_1.outputs: structured teaching references and interactive tutoring dialogues

answer_2.quote: We evaluate the f 1 models from the following aspects: (1) Local Clue Analysis Capability: the alignment of the decoupled local clues with teaching references using metrics Bert C and M eteor C ; the accuracy (Acc P N ) between predicted and ground-truth stances for each clue; the semantic and textual quality of reasoning explanations measured by Bert P N and M eteor P N ; ...

answer_4.quote: For evaluating the pedagogical value of Teaching References, we enlisted three experienced educators, each with over a decade of medical teaching experience. These experts evaluated 60 Teaching References... From the learning perspective, we engaged five medical students to assess the quality of local and global dialogues generated by our f 2 and f 3 models respectively.
answer_4.guideline: Participants in both evaluations ranked outputs on a 1-to-3 scale, with 1 being most preferred. We quantified preferences using Mean Reciprocal Rank (MRR).
criteria: quality of local and global dialogues
